newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sino Land shares fall on dilution fear.
newsitem.headline: Sino Land shares fall on dilution fear.

text.p: Shares of Sino Land Co Ltd, which topped the list of most actively traded by turnover, fell on selling triggered by dilution fear after it announced a HK$2.12 billion shares placement, brokers said on Monday.
Its shares fell HK$0.35 or 3.65 percent to HK$9.25 each in early afternoon trade on volume of 246.48 million shares worth HK$2.25 billion.
"Fear of a dilution effect following share placement triggered selling," said a sales manager at a local brokerage.
Analysts said they expected the shares to have a limited downside due to the company's relatively strong earnings outlook and positive use of the proceed.

Sino Land on Friday agreed to place 238 million new shares to controlling shareholder Tsim Sha Tsui Properties Ltd, raising HK$2.12 billion to fund purchase and development of its property projects in Hong Kong.
Tsim Sha Tsui privately placed 238 million existing shares at HK$9.13 per share.
Shares of Tsim Sha Tsui Properties rose HK$0.10 to HK$15 in ealry afternoon trade with 182,000 shares changed hand.
